notes.title: Balancelot: Halloween Island - Free Update 1.0.3!
notes.notes:
[h1]Well met, Lances and Laines![/h1]

As we hinted in the previous patch notes, we have a little something for you!
A spooky island has appeared on the world map. What could be hidden on it? Find out by playing our new [b]FREE UPDATE 1.0.3[/b]!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
- Updated World Map
- Added 5 new Levels
- Added 3 new Characters

Happy Halloween, everyone!

notes.title: Balancelot Update 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Well met, Lances and Laines![/h1]

It's been some time since the last update. Our development team has been busy, but rest assured: updates will be coming! In fact, we've got something special planned for Balancelot in the near future.
To give a small taste of what we have to offer, our free update 1.0.2 brings two new characters for you to adventure with through the land of Fopdoodle - The Frog and The Fox!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Moving platforms' collider’s shape is now corrected
- VSync is now on by default on all quality settings and you can disable it if you so choose

[b]Gameplay & Usability Adjustments[/b]
- Controls can now be rebound if needed
- There are still some quirks (no icons for buttons etc) but rebounding should be - usable
- Some new functions can be bound on keys now:
     - Give Up
     - Restart from Checkpoint 
     - Restart Level
- Added some more info to Level selection:
     - Icons for completed levels without deaths
     - Amount of Collectibles collected
- You can now see requirements for unlocking characters
- There are now 2 new characters you can play as!

notes.title: Balancelot Update v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings![/h1]

We have just released an update which solves a couple of issues found in the game after launch. The team is still looking at bug fixes for a couple of known issues, but progress is being made!
We here at AnvilBird and Jestercraft would like to thank you all for the support of our humble little game! We have received a ton of positive feedback, including an unexpected amount of visibility on live streaming websites. Our game has even reached the top page on Twitch several times now, which we could not be happier about! 
If this keeps up, we might have a little something for you in the near future... Stay tuned. ;)

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
- Leaderboards are now updated correctly on when getting a new record
- Fixed a bug where the player character could get stuck on the rotating wheels
- Collecting all collectibles now triggers the achievement properly
- "Dante Who?"-achievement is now triggered correctly
- Controller now works correctly in Mini Levels' pause menu

[h1]Gameplay and Usability Adjustments[/h1]
- Player's most recent played level will be used as the selection when coming back to level selection screen
- Moving platforms now reset back to starting location when continuing from checkpoint
- The collectible on level 16 is now easier to obtain
